title: Case: Return approved but the customer has no return label
context: The merchant approved a return, but has not issued its printable label. A real synthetic label facsimile is included for exercise completeness, not actual shipping.
initial_request:
The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: Return RT-8960 for TG-3735 / DL-3980 is approved. The label field is empty. Our authorised label team needs to issue the label against RT-8960 before the customer can prepare the return.

The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Label issuance is not return collection, warehouse receipt or refund.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-031: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
